title: Grand Theft Auto VI set for November 19, 2026
summary: Rockstar's Newswire says Grand Theft Auto VI will now release on Thursday, November 19, 2026.

title: Pre-orders and pricing announced
summary: Take-Two announced Grand Theft Auto VI pre-orders for a November 19, 2026 launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Standard Edition is $79.99 and Ultimate Edition is $99.99. Digital pre-orders can pre-load starting November 12, 2026. Physical copies include a download code and go on sale that same day. Update: on November 3, 2026, Rockstar moved digital pre-loading up to November 10; boxed copies still arrive November 12.

title: Pre-load moves up to November 10; up to 212 GB
summary: Rockstar's Newswire says digital pre-loading starts November 10, 2026: at midnight local time on PlayStation 5 and at 12 a.m. GMT worldwide on Xbox Series X|S. Code-in-box copies arrive at retailers from November 12. The pre-load file needs up to 212 GB depending on the console. Launch is still November 19, 2026.
